research_question: Can an exact hypothesis-driven W-method replace exhaustive all-strings conformance at the same source-only rights and trusted reference state bound N<=5?
scope: POSTFIRST SAME 24 ALREADY OPEN RC39 tasks. Never claim newly unseen transfer, neural discovery, global Q3/Q6 or 10x end-to-end model cost.
reference: RC39 original membership-only 24 tasks. Original FIRST: 172051 unique membership words, 1362696 unique source symbols, 172499 conformance probes.
method: Known classical Mealy W-method. Reachable pairwise-distinguishable m-state candidate. Test (state_cover UNION transition_cover)·Sigma^[0..N-m]·characterization_set, N=5. Any untrusted state bound, nonminimal/ unreachable model, or budget violation => UNKNOWN.
rights: All learner and conformance access to target MUST pass through membership(input_word) returning output_word only. Target transition graph available to independent auditor AFTER model frozen.
prereg_primary_gate: W method 24/24 independently exact all-length PASS, 24/24 original exhaustive reference PASS, ZERO false certificates; W unique membership query total <= 17205 (>=10x reduction in same rights/query count).
explicit_secondary_gate: Same-runner compare W against full-string baseline, source characters, process CPU; report even if query primary gate fails. Synthetic mutation false-cert rate ZERO.
failure: Retain original first result even if FAIL. Never rerun failed first to select favorable result. No leftover ARC original 11 IDs touched.
future_external_generalization: A newly authored external-domain family with precommitted source-only reference rights, controlled fresh task generation, equal-rights strong classic baseline, and independent product proof is required for Q6. This reopened24 test is insufficient.
